name: Quick Brown
storyline:
For generations, the human civilization and the animal civilization have been separated by a single, impossible boundary: a huge, lazy, sleeping dog. Nothing has ever crossed from one world to the other.

One day, a mysterious odour drifts from the direction of the sleeping dog.
By the time it reaches the forest, nearly every animal has been transformed into a meerkat.
The phenomenon comes to be known as the Scrumption.
95% of the animals are transformed into meerkats.

They remember everything.
They can still speak.
Only their appearance has changed.
A small few, including Cubey, remain unaffected — possibly due to genetics. No one knows for sure.

You play as Cubey, a fox determined to rid the forest of the Scrumption.

Along the way, Cubey encounters Scaram, a human who somehow ended up in the animal world and desperately wants to return home. Scaram claims that the cure for Scrumption exists in the human civilization, and that they can go there by collecting 26 ancient relics scattered throughout the depths of the forest.
summary: Quick Brown is a cute and cozy 2d puzzle platformer about a fox trying to collect all 26 letters of the alphabet scattered across a forest. It is the first game of the "Subspace" Franchise created by Subanshh.
